single.rationale: NCR Atleos shows operational improvement with expanding operating margins (6.3% to 11.0%) and strengthening cash generation, but operates in a mature ATM/self-service banking market with minimal revenue growth (1-2% CAGR). The company carries substantial debt ($2.7B vs $456M cash) and faces secular headwinds from digital payments, though its pivot to software-led ATM-as-a-Service and the Allpoint network offers some growth optionality that warrants monitoring.
